Code immediately revokes all known same-PID and conservative unknown assignments; compiled policy evidence does not establish a real multi-instance shared-renderer crash.

Native same-browser resize permits only a previously unused geometry and creates a new immutable epoch/mailbox/consumer. A-to-B-to-A is rejected with resize_requires_cold_replacement; a caller must perform controlled browser replacement. The Rust manager requires replacement absent an authenticated hot-resize barrier.

Lease validity, completion, drop/revocation and telemetry take a metadata mutex. This is not a certified nonblocking OBS render callback API; future binary transport and texture ownership require a worker/render barrier and H17 handoff.
Explicit Chromium test/mock Keychain backend is not proof of a safe production credential configuration or normal production shutdown.
CEF sandbox remains enabled; observed renderer decoy denial and web-probe rejection do not establish whole-browser, GPU, service, filesystem, credentials, network or hostile IPC confinement.

Original three-widget acquisition FPS failure is retained; five-widget passing repetitions do not cancel it. Consumer work duration includes scheduling and completion, not isolated disk I/O. Full frozen matrix, per-frame byte/visual-counter analysis, AVFPS, real libobs upload and exclusive physical-memory attribution are not accepted by this governance review.
